title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Description – Full Stack Developer

**Position:** Full Stack Developer  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Delhi  
**Department:** IT

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and motivated **Full Stack Developer** to join our development team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining scalable web applications using **React.js, Angular, ASP.NET Core, C#, and Microsoft SQL Server**.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in frontend and backend development, database design, API development, and performance optimization. Experience working on **Accounting, Inventory Management, Production Management, or ERP applications will be highly preferred.**

Key Responsibilities

* Develop responsive and user-friendly web applications using React.js and Angular.
* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core and C#.
* Design and optimize SQL Server databases, tables, views, stored procedures, and queries.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, and role-based access control.
* Develop reusable components and maintain clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
* Troubleshoot bugs, resolve production issues, and improve application performance.
* Understand business requirements and convert them into effective technical solutions.
* Perform code reviews, testing, debugging, and database optimization.
* Use Git for version control and follow standard development practices.
* Deploy, maintain, and support applications across development, testing, and production environments.
* Collaborate with team members, QA engineers, project managers, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain technical documentation and support ongoing application enhancements.

Required Technical Skills1. Frontend Development

* Strong hands-on experience with React.js and Angular.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Experience with Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, or similar UI frameworks.
* Understanding of component-based architecture, state management, form validation, and REST API integration.
* Ability to develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces.

2. Backend Development

* Strong knowledge of C# and ASP.NET Core / .NET Core.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Knowledge of Entity Framework Core, LINQ, and Dependency Injection.
* Understanding of middleware, exception handling, logging, and API validation.
* Experience with JWT authentication, authorization, and role-based access control.
* Knowledge of SOLID principles and clean coding practices.

3. Database Management

* Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server.
* Experience in database design, normalization, and relational database concepts.
* Proficiency in complex SQL queries, joins, subqueries, and CTEs.
* Hands-on experience with stored procedures, views, functions, and indexing.
* Understanding of query optimization, transactions, concurrency, and database performance tuning.

4. Development Tools

* Experience with Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Visual Studio, VS Code, and Postman.
* Understanding of debugging, testing, and CI/CD concepts.
* Basic knowledge of Docker and application deployment will be an advantage.

Preferred Domain Experience

Candidates with practical experience developing or maintaining any of the following business applications will be given preference:

* **Accounting Software / Financial Management Systems**
* **Inventory Management Software**
* **Production Management / Manufacturing Software**
* **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) Applications**
* Purchase, sales, billing, stock management, and reporting modules.

The candidate should understand business workflows, data accuracy, transaction handling, and the relationship between different modules of a business application.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and suggest suitable technical solutions.
* Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks.
* Attention to detail and commitment to code quality.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and meet project deadlines.

Education

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Candidates with relevant practical experience may also be considered.

Experience Requirements

* **3–5 years of professional experience** in full stack web application development.
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js / Angular, ASP.NET Core, C#, and SQL Server.
* Experience working on real-world business applications in a professional development environment.
* Candidates with experience in Accounting, Inventory, Production Management, or ERP software will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who can independently understand requirements, develop frontend screens, build backend APIs, manage database operations, and deliver reliable business applications with minimal supervision.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Angular: 2 years (Required)
* total work: 2 years (Required)
* .NET Core: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Full Stack Developer

Key Responsibilities

* Create wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma.
* Develop responsive and interactive frontend interfaces using React.js, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Transform Figma designs into functional, pixel-perfect frontend components.
* Improve existing application interfaces to enhance usability, navigation, and user engagement.
* Develop reusable UI components and maintain consistent design systems.
* Work on typography, color combinations, layouts, animations, and interactive elements.
* Ensure smooth user experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Collaborate with developers to integrate APIs and implement new features.
* Identify and resolve UI/UX issues while optimizing frontend performance.
* Stay updated with modern design trends and frontend technologies.

Required Skills

* UI/UX Design
* Figma
* React.js
* JavaScript
* HTML5 & CSS3
* Responsive Web Design
* Wireframing & Prototyping
* User Interface Designing
* Frontend Development
* Creative Problem-Solving
* Design Systems & Component Libraries

Preferred Skills

* TypeScript
* React Native
* Tailwind CSS
* REST API Integration
* Git & GitHub
* Basic understanding of Node.js and Supabase

Candidate Requirements

* Strong creative thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to design professional, modern, and visually engaging interfaces.
* Good understanding of user experience and usability principles.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with a development team.
* A portfolio showcasing UI/UX projects, Figma designs, dashboards, or mobile applications is highly preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical skills and an impressive portfolio are welcome to apply.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can go beyond basic templates and create **unique, premium-quality, visually impressive, and user-friendly digital experiences.**

**Note:** Strong Figma skills, creativity, and frontend development knowledge will be given priority.

Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Full Stack Developer (Node.JS & React.JS)
description:
**Job Title \- Full Stack Developer (Node.JS \& React.JS)**

(Multiple Openings, early joiners will be preferred)

**Work Location: U.S Complex, Adjacent to Jasola Apollo Metro Station, Mathura Road New Delhi\-110076**

**Background of the Role:**

We @**Infinity Assurance** specialize in Warranty Service Administration, Extended Warranty, Accidental Damage Protection and a wide range of service products under our own brand “**Infyshield**.” Our offerings cover Mobile Phones, Home Appliances, Consumer Electronics, IT Equipment, Office Automation, AV Solutions, Classroom and Conference Room Technologies, Kitchen Appliances and more.

We have a very extensive Enterprise grade End to End Business Management Software Application that is unmatched in the industry.

The application has multiple Sub\-applications and functionalities including Sales, Insurance Claims, Warranty Claims, Payments, Collections, Approvals, Billing / Invoicing, Payment / Tax / Bank Reconciliations, Partners Management, HRMS, Client Management etc. to suite end to end business needs of any enterprise.

**The application also has** **multiple integrations for Payment gateways, Voice calls, Video Calls, SMS, emails, WhatsApp, client applications, courier, Maps etc.**

To fuel our growth, we are inviting Software Developers as we are building our software development team to execute new business growth plans and a fresh product roadmap.

This position requires talents who are multi\-skilled with hands\-on experience; to work independently as well as in teams.

**Candidate Profile:**

* Must have previous application development experience in **JavaScript**, **ReactJS**, **NestJS**, Typescripts, HTML, CSS.
* Design, develop, and maintain server\-side applications using **Node.js** frameworks
* Demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end **NextJS** development.
* Knowledge and experience in integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs.
* Understanding of web security best practices.
* Experience in building responsive and visually appealing user interfaces
* Have good debugging, troubleshooting skills and best practices for performance improvement of the application
* Exposure to Android and iOS App development will be preferred

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech. in CS or IT with a minimum of 3**\+ years** professional experience (must mention the stream of engineering)
* Prior experience in developing **FINTECH / Customer Service / Logistics applications will be desire**

**Important Notes \& Perks:**

* Attractive pay structure as per the Market Standards
* Huge career growth opportunity
* Preference will be given to candidates who can join early
* Should have worked in small teams with multi\-skilled resources
* This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office opportunity (Monday to Saturday; 6 days a week), based in South Delhi.
* *Applications may be submitted via google form as per the link:* ***https://forms.gle/qu2vmEkQUhjZyeZh6***

**About us:**

We, Infinity Assurance Solutions, Private Limited, a New Delhi\-based portfolio company of Indian Angel Network, Aegis Centre for Entrepreneurship, Artha Venture Fund, eVista Venture and other marquee industry veterans; specialize in Warranty Service Administration, Extended Warranty, Accidental Damage Protection and various other service products for wide range of Mobile Phones, Home Appliances, Consumer Electronics, AV Solutions, Classroom / Conference\-room Solutions, Kitchen Appliances, IT, Office automation, Personal Gadgets etc.

Incorporated in January 2014; as a debt\-free, operationally profitable with positive net retained earnings, we have grown rapidly. Going forward, we are looking to grow multi\-fold with newer areas of business expansion.

Our success is attributed to a very agile and technologically driven unique service delivery model, loyal long\-term clients, in\-house application, and lean organization structure.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Developer
description:
**Senior Full\-Stack Software Developer**

**Location:** South Ex, New Delhi  
**Experience:** 8\+ Years

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands\-on **Senior Full\-Stack Developer / Technical Lead** with strong frontend and backend expertise, leadership experience, excellent communication skills, and practical knowledge of AI technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, deploy and maintain scalable web applications.
* Build high\-quality frontend, backend, APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Work with SQL/NoSQL databases and optimize performance, security and scalability.
* Drive architecture, system design and technical decision\-making.
* Conduct code reviews and establish engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and ensure timely delivery.
* Mentor and technically guide developers.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, Business and Management teams.
* Identify and implement practical AI/GenAI use cases.

**Technical Skills**

**Frontend:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, Angular/Vue, REST APIs, responsive UI.

**Backend:** Node.js, Express/NestJS, Java/Spring Boot, Python/Django/FastAPI, PHP/Laravel or equivalent.

**Database:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL, MongoDB, Redis or equivalent.

**Cloud \& DevOps:** AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git and cloud deployment.

**Architecture:** System design, microservices, SOLID principles, scalability, security and performance optimization.

**AI:** Generative AI, LLMs, AI APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, AI agents and AI\-powered automation.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 8\+ years of professional software development experience.
* Strong full\-stack development expertise.
* Prior team management or technical leadership experience.
* Strong architecture and system\-design knowledge.
* Experience with production\-grade applications, APIs and databases.
* Practical AI/GenAI knowledge.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

**Education:** Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or related field preferred.

Ideal Candidate

A technology professional capable of independently owning a product/module from **Requirement → Architecture → Development → Testing → Deployment → Maintenance**, while leading and mentoring the engineering team.

Pay: ₹1,400,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
